tasks.contract: ResetSelected(states []State,selected []bool) int. State fields are Count int, Active bool, Name string, Values []int, Labels map[string]int, Target *int. Lengths are equal. Replace every selected State with its exact Go zero value, including nil slice/map/pointer fields; preserve every unselected State including container/header/pointer identity. Do not alter previous slice backing elements, map entries or pointees, even when shared across selected/unselected states or saved copies. Preserve selected. Return the number of true entries, including already-zero selected states; nil/empty inputs return zero. Repeated calls and repopulation obey the same contract. Input-domain boundary: every nonnil Target points to an integer outside the backing array of states; pointers into any State field in that backing array are excluded.
tasks.distinct_from: zero-results-001 constructs fresh zeros; receiver-reset-001 resets one receiver. This operation selectively zeroes a slice of aggregates, preserves unselected owners and shared data, and counts selection rather than changed/nonzero states.

tasks.contract: ReplaceRuneRange(s string,lo,hi int,replacement string)(string,bool): both strings are valid UTF-8. For 0<=lo<=hi<=rune count(s), replace the half-open rune range with replacement, preserving all other code points in order, and return true. Empty range inserts, including at end; empty replacement removes. Indices count code points, not bytes or grapheme clusters; combining code points count separately. Invalid bounds return the exact original s,false without panicking. Empty strings are valid.
